Ashley: quick heads-up — opened a tiny PR to add a concise polyglot snippet that demonstrates streaming + pagination with retries/backoff for py/ts/go. want a quick accuracy/style pass before i land it. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4822 :wave:
DocsBot: PR #4822 created by Ashley — CI queued (md-lint, snippet-checker) :gear:
Mike: skimmed. love it. one request: add a short note about client-side backpressure (how to yield/await between chunks). otherwise LGTM. :+1:
Jordan: can we show resume semantics? i.e. how to use a cursor from pagination to keep streaming after an interrupt. small snippet would help users migrating from sync streams.
Ashley: yep — plan is to show: start streaming for a page, emit chunks, and if interrupted call get_page(cursor) to resume. i'll draft a python example.
Ashley: python sketch (will tidy):
```python
async def stream_paginated(client, cursor=None):
    while True:
        resp = await client.get_page(cursor=cursor, page_size=32)
        for chunk in resp.stream():
            yield chunk
            await asyncio.sleep(0)  # backpressure hint
        if not resp.next_cursor:
            break
        cursor = resp.next_cursor
```
Mike: looks good. maybe replace sleep(0) with a short comment about how apps should adapt (blocking vs async). also mention retry wrapper around get_page for transient 5xx.
Liz: small formatting thing — wrap code blocks with language and keep line lengths < 88 for docs site. i'll add a prettier/black style hook in CI if you want.
Sam: i can test the go snippet on linux + with go vet. if you want a hands-on check i'll run the example against the local test server. ping me when PR is updated.
Elena: add a note about KV cache: streaming responses that rely on model kv cache might behave differently when resuming from page-level results. short callout in 'gotchas' would save support tickets.
Ashley: good call. i'll add a small 'caveats' paragraph. also adding a TypeScript example — plan: use async iterator from client.streamPages() and show `for await` with try/retry.
Ashley: typescript quick snippet (draft):
```ts
for await (const page of client.streamPages({ pageSize: 32 })) {
  for (const chunk of page.chunks) {
    console.log(chunk.text)
    // implement backpressure here if needed
  }
}
```
Jordan: for TS, also show how to call a helper `retryWithBackoff(fn, opts)` around the page fetch. helps connect the docs to our retry utilities.
Liz: i'll add CI lint job to catch missing language tags and trailing whitespace in fenced blocks. i'll open a tiny PR against the docs CI pipeline after this lands.
Mike: suggestion: place all three polyglot snippets in a single collapsible 'Examples' section, and a single tiny table comparing behavior (resume support / kv-cache caveat / intended latency). keeps the page compact.
Ashley: agreed. i'll consolidate and aim to include the table. target to push updates by EOD tomorrow.
